title: Non-blocking finding from frontend-cftc-cot-display-followups-followups's PR review (#412)
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's full review of PR #412 (frontend-cftc-cot-display-followups-followups), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges. PR #412 itself was accepted with no blocking findings -- the isKnown -> isKnownNumber consolidation was verified byte-equivalent at every one of the ~20 touched call sites (including the two inline waveHelp.interpretValue copies), formatNullableNumber's behavior was confirmed unchanged (De Morgan equivalence plus its own null/undefined/NaN tests still passing), a mutation test against isKnownNumber's NaN guard was caught by both format.test.ts and metricHelpContent.test.ts, the utils/chart.ts#isFiniteNumber rejection was confirmed accurate (materially different predicate, different param type, and that module top-level-imports lightweight-charts), the full test/coverage/lint/typecheck/validate_tasks.py suites all pass clean, and a Playwright walkthrough of both the stock detail page's indicator help tooltips and the watchlist page's CftcCotCard help tooltip (including describeExtreme's dynamic 'most/least bullish' text) rendered correctly with no console errors, plus the full e2e suite (28/28 specs) passed.

checklist.step: `frontend/src/features/portfolio/components/metricHelpContent.ts` line 28 has a doc comment -- "not 'no interpretation available' the way e.g. IndicatorsPanel's `isKnown` guard treats a stale/malformed latest bar" -- that's now a stale symbol reference: PR #412 renamed the guard it's describing (originally a private `isKnown` in `features/stocks/components/metricHelpContent.ts`, consumed by `IndicatorsPanel.tsx`) to the shared `isKnownNumber` in `utils/format.ts`, but this cross-file comment in a third, untouched file wasn't updated to match. Purely a documentation drift, not a behavior bug (confirmed via grep that no other file still references the old bare `isKnown` name as a currently-live symbol) -- worth a one-line comment fix (`isKnown` -> `isKnownNumber`) next time this file is touched.
